files.content:
---
title: Release notes format
description: Where release notes go and how they are laid out
---
Release notes live in release-notes.txt at the top of the workspace. The file starts with the line "Release notes", a blank line, then one bullet per change.

---
title: Write release notes
description: Write release-notes.txt in one step
---
1. Call write_file once with path release-notes.txt.
2. Content: "Release notes", a blank line, then "- " and the change.
No drafts and no exploring are needed.

decisions.reason: A durable fact about where the notes go.
The run finished the job; the steps are reusable.
